title: Etale localization commutes with direct image of arbitrary space modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be an etale morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Put $X\prime=X\times_Y Y\prime$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], with projections $h:X\prime\to X$ and $f\prime:X\prime\to Y\prime$. For a sheaf $F$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], direct image means module direct image on small etale ringed topoi. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $(f_*F)|_{Y\prime}\xrightarrow{\sim}f\prime_*(F|_{X\prime})$. For an etale scheme $V\to Y\prime$, it identifies both sides with the sections of $F$ over $X\times_YV=X\prime\times_{Y\prime}V$; sections over this space mean compatible sections on its etale scheme charts. The comparison is the identity on these compatible sections, and is compatible with restriction in $V$ and with module morphisms in $F$. For any etale map $u:Z\prime\to Z$ of algebraic spaces, $u^{-1}\mathcal O_Z\simeq\mathcal O_{Z\prime}$ and the tensor pullback $u^*M=\mathcal O_{Z\prime}\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O_Z}u^{-1}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is this restriction of modules on the localized etale sites. For every module $G$ on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$, the square also has a canonical natural tensor-pullback comparison $(f^*G)|_{X\prime}\simeq f\prime^*(G|_{Y\prime})$, where $f^*$ and $f\prime^*$ are the tensor pullbacks along the induced morphisms of ringed topoi. On local tensors this comparison keeps the restricted section and multiplies the two scalar coefficients; it identifies the two paths from $Y$ to $X\prime$.

proof.text: For the tensor-restriction helper, representable etaleness implies chartwise etaleness by isEtale_comp. Obtain the normalized tensor presentation L and its etale multiplication isomorphism sigma from chart tensor realization. Compose L.comparison with sigma; L.chartTensor and the multiplication clause prove exactly the asserted section formula.

For moduleChartBaseChange_triangle, the specialized CostructuredArrow.w for q gives its chart triangle. Postcompose by g, apply the equality h≫f=f′≫g on underlying presheaves, and reassociate. This proves the existing transport definition without a postponed triangle proof.

Apply representableWith_baseChange to the presheaf image of the flipped pullback square. Since g is representably etale, this proves that h is representably etale, without any covering or surjectivity assumption.

Apply the direct-image chart comparison to obtain beta and its projection formula. Its explicit transport is definitionally moduleChartBaseChange: both use the same scheme object and q.hom.left, and the triangle proofs are propositionally irrelevant.

Apply the tensor comparison for a commutative etale square using hp.w to obtain lambda and its local tensor formula. Package h-etaleness, beta, lambda, and their independent formulas into the original existential conjunction. No compatibility between beta and lambda beyond their stated normalizations is asserted by this theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03LX, 03LV and 03LW. The degree-zero direct-image and tensor-composition assertions are separated into their independent comparisons; the etaleness of h follows by representable base change.

lean.note: The main theorem states both natural comparison isomorphisms and fixes their components on every compatible scheme-chart section and every local tensor. The same module defines the explicit restricted structure-sheaf isomorphism and states the etale tensor-restriction isomorphism normalized by a tensor m maps to a m. A cartesian sheaf square is used instead of choosing one particular fibre product; it is the same universal fibre-product hypothesis and adds no representability or surjectivity assumption.
